method_change: round 1's pressed edge band + flat lower flange read as a thin rim round a recessed panel with a groove; round 2 is one solid plate with a dark edge groove and a tilted valley wedge whose crease wall faces up. A raised-rib variant (the judge's word) was built and rendered: its lower wall faces down under the upper-left key and renders dark, the opposite of c1, so it was rejected.
